text: {"lessons":["Selling part of Stock A after substantial gains reduced my exposure while keeping some shares invested; I should make such decisions deliberately, not chase short-term prices.","A brief rise in account value does not ensure lasting gains—the value dipped again in Period 10—so I should avoid assuming recent performance will continue.","Because I rely on these savings in retirement, I should keep overall risk and concentration manageable, while reviewing my holdings and cash rather than trading for its own sake."]}
